meta.head: febe73b15
meta.fixture_used: #5536 A9001 (created status=4 to demo clean multi-line note + dessert + standalone drink on a VISIBLE card; DELETED after capture, board restored)
meta.method: Live KDS board (/kds) DOM + PNG read; kitchen-ticket ESC/POS bytes rendered server-side via EscPosTicketBytesService::render(1,orderId,'kitchen') and decoded byte-by-byte at width 32 (ESC/GS command stripping, CP858->UTF8, per-line column width, underline-region tracking).

findings.title: Notes client sur ecran KDS (multi-ligne, nettoyee, pre-line)

evidence.screen: Fixture card A9001 renders note in 3 lines: '[Sans oignon cru — BIEN CUIT svp' / 'Allergie arachide & œufs' / 'Merci beaucoup l'equipe]'. CSS white-space=pre-line (confirmed getComputedStyle on .kds-line__instruction-text). œ + em-dash render natively. The 'CAYENNE' uppercase echo AND the 'Pain - Salade, Tomate, Oignons cuits Sauce : Algerienne' compo blob are STRIPPED (not shown) => clean, no compo echo.
evidence.real_orders: Board also carries real free notes: #5528 rich multi-line bracket note, #5501 'oignons cuits'. #5535 shows a multi-line bracket note rendered with pre-line (line breaks respected).
evidence.ticket: Fixture #5536 kitchen ticket keeps ONLY the note (wrapped at 32): '** [Sans oignon cru - BIEN' / 'CUIT svp' / '** Allergie arachide & oeufs' / '** Merci beaucoup l'equipe]'; CAYENNE echo + compo blob stripped by cleanInstruction (PHP twin).

findings.title: Boissons visibles cuisine (nom complet) + dessert jamais classe boisson

evidence.drinks_full_name_screen: A0012/A0013 'BOISSON: Hawaï 33cl'; A0014 'BOISSON: Fuze Tea 33cl', standalone 'Coca-Cola 33cl', 'Sprite 33cl', '4× Coca-Cola 33cl'; fixture '2× Coca-Cola 33cl'. Full names, never 'HAW'/'FUZ'/'COC'.
evidence.drinks_full_name_ticket: Decoded bytes: '** BOISSON: Hawaï 33cl' (Hawaï ï preserved CP858), '** BOISSON: Fuze Tea 33cl', '1 x Coca-Cola 33cl', '1 x Sprite 33cl', '4 x Coca-Cola 33cl' (standalone + menu-boisson).
evidence.standalone_and_menu: menu-boisson channel ('BOISSON: X' from formule) AND standalone drink items both render full name on screen + ticket.
evidence.dessert_not_drink: KitchenTicketSymbolicFormatter::isDrinkItem twin (parity with kdsCustomization.categorize): 13 real drinks (Coca/Hawaï/Sprite/Fanta/Orangina/Perrier/Fuze Tea/Oasis/Ice Tea/Capri-Sun/Tropico/Eau/Jus) => DRINK; 3 desserts (Tarte Daim, Glace, Tiramisu) => NOT drink. Fixture Tarte Daim renders as food item '1× TAR' (screen) / '1 x TAR' (ticket) via the symbolic-main path, NEVER the drink full-name path.

findings.title: Symbole O̲ (oignons cuits) - souligne ecran, ESC-1/ESC-0 ticket

evidence.screen: DOM contains 'STO̲' with U+0332 combining low line on the O (regex /O̲/ matches; hasUnderlineO=true). Renders as underlined O natively. Order S T O̲ (canonical CRUDITE_ORDER S,T,O,O̲).
evidence.ticket_bytes: Decoded region: 'S','T', then ESC(1B) '-' 01, 'O'(4F), ESC(1B) '-' 00 => hardware underline on the O ONLY. Each ticket with oignon cuit = exactly 1 ESC-1 (ON) + 1 ESC-0 (OFF). Confirmed on #5533, #5534, fixture #5536.
evidence.width: Underline consumes 0 columns (EscPosCommandBuilder::visibleWidth strips U+0332); all ticket lines <= 32 cols.

findings.title: Layout 3-cartes plein-ecran intact (pastille +N, codes 3 lettres, inline)

evidence.grid: KdsV2Grid visibleActiveOrders = activeOrders.slice(0,3). Exactly 3 full-height cards. Landscape: w=595, h=1544. Portrait: w=1253, h=1920. All no-overflow.
evidence.overflow_badge: '+1 en attente' orange badge shown when a 4th active order queued (A0014 displaced during fixture demo) => pastille +N exacte.
evidence.codes: 3-letter product codes CAY (Cayenne), TAC (Tacos), TAR (Tarte Daim); size M; MENU / 'MENU : ALG' badges inline. New lines (note, boisson) did NOT break the card (no truncation/overflow/scroll break).

evidence.A0012: screen 'S | CAY | STO̲ | ALG' + 'MENU : ALG' + 'BOISSON: Hawaï 33cl'  ==  ticket '1 x S | CAY | STO | ALG'(O underlined) + 'MENU : ALG' + '** BOISSON: Hawaï 33cl'.
evidence.note: Identical symbol content on both surfaces. Differences are decoration only: screen prefix '·' + native combining underline; ticket prefix '**' + ESC-hardware underline; ticket wraps line-1 to 2 rows at 32 cols. PHP KitchenTicketSymbolicFormatter is a strict twin of JS kdsSymbolic.js (documented lockstep + parity spec tests/js/kdsSymbolic.spec.js).

findings.title: Console KDS propre (0 erreur Vue nouvelle, 0 fuite i18n)

evidence.vue_errors: 0 new Vue errors across all board loads.
evidence.i18n: 0 raw label leaks. All labels resolved FR (NOUVELLE, EN COURS, BORNE, CAISSE, ATTENTE, Pret, EN ATTENTE ENCAISSEMENT, RECEMMENT SERVIES). No 'label.x' / 'kds.x' / undefined / NaN.
evidence.out_of_scope_observation: 1 console error: 403 GET /api/admin/kds-order/sync (Cross-branch guard in KdsSyncController::sync, the degraded-poll fallback). Orthogonal to cuisine rendering (auth/branch-scope, not Vue/i18n). Board still renders via /kds index endpoint. Pre-existing / environmental (session appended branch_id=1 on the poll); NOT introduced by kitchen-symbolic work. Logged as P3 note, not a cuisine blocker.
